archetype: Hybrid (Archetype 7: Cypher, Archetype 5: Business, Archetype 3: Millennium, Archetype 2/4: Stealth)

logo_concept.description: Original OurRealm logo featuring a sleek, futuristic wordmark and an iconic emblem. The emblem is an 'Orbital Glyph' - an intersecting dynamic dual-ring surrounding a stylized, sharp-angled 'R'. The logo's stroke and glow adapt seamlessly to each mode's aesthetic.

mode_adaptations.cypher: Neon blue/purple glow via SVG filters (drop-shadow).
mode_adaptations.millennium: Glossy rounded 3D effect with soft blue gradient.
mode_adaptations.stealth: Tactical dark green stroke, matte finish, slight radar pulse animation.

global_design_rules.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Gap-6 or gap-8 for bento grids.
global_design_rules.border_radius: Varies heavily by mode. Global structure supports scalable components.
global_design_rules.animation: Framer Motion for all mode transitions and widget dragging.
global_design_rules.accessibility: Always ensure > 4.5:1 text contrast. Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
global_design_rules.layout_strategy: Widget-based bento grids for profiles. Netflix-style horizontal scroll rows for Discover page. Fluid masonry or standard list for Feed.

cypher.name: Cypher Mode
cypher.aesthetic: Cyberpunk future, holographic, electric, digital grids.
cypher.surfaces: Glassmorphism with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-2xl), 1px solid neon borders, inner glows (box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(176,38,255,0.2)). Floating holographic panels.
cypher.motion: Fast, elastic spring animations. Particle effects on hover. Neon borders trace around cards.

business.name: Business Mode
business.aesthetic: Executive luxury, bright, premium, metallic accents, elegant.
business.surfaces: Frosted crystal glass (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl), subtle gold shimmer gradients, very soft ambient drop shadows (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]), no harsh borders.
business.motion: Smooth, ease-in-out, slow and deliberate. Elegant fades.

millennium.name: Millennium Mode
millennium.aesthetic: Early internet nostalgia (Y2K), glossy, optimistic, soft blue gradients, friendly.
millennium.surfaces: Glossy panels, highly rounded corners (rounded-3xl), linear gradients simulating 3D bevels, strong distinct box-shadows.
millennium.motion: Bouncy, playful. Buttons press down physically (translate-y-1).

stealth.name: Stealth Mode
stealth.aesthetic: Tactical intelligence, encrypted, secure, radar, terminal, deep black.
stealth.surfaces: Completely flat, square edges (rounded-none), 1px solid green borders, scanline background overlays, terminal-style layout.
stealth.motion: Instant, zero-delay transitions. Glitch effects on load. Blinking cursors.

landing_page.structure: Center floating logo panel with 'Live. Connect. Experience.' and 3 buttons (SIGN UP, SIGN IN, BROWSE AS GUEST). Background divided into 4 interactive quadrants representing the modes.
landing_page.quadrants: Top Left (Cypher), Top Right (Business), Bottom Left (Millennium), Bottom Right (Stealth). Hovering expands quadrant, clicking locks the app into that mode theme.

navigation_and_header.global_mode_switcher: A highly prominent pill-shaped toggle or badge near the logo. Displays the current mode and allows switching. Switches entire CSS/Tailwind variables instantly.
navigation_and_header.upload_button: Center prominent '+' button. Opens a highly styled radial or bento menu for (Live Stream, Video, Photo Album, Thought, Link).
navigation_and_header.media_filter_bar: Horizontal scrollable pills on the feed (Images / Videos / Lives / Sounds / Posts).

discover_page.structure: Netflix-style horizontal scrolling rows categorized by Trending, Music, Videos, Lives, News, Crypto, etc.

wallet_page.structure: Uses Shadcn Charts (recharts) for Creator Rewards, Shop Commissions, Royalties. Data visualization styling adapts to the active mode (e.g., neon lines for Cypher, gold bars for Business).

testing_guidelines.attributes: All buttons, inputs, mode switchers, and widgets MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="mode-switcher-cypher"', 'data-testid="nav-upload-button"').

landing_quadrant_cypher.description: Vibrant cyberpunk neon alleyway for Cypher mode background.

landing_quadrant_business.description: Luxury white marble interior for Business mode background.

landing_quadrant_millennium.description: Nostalgic retro blue sky aesthetic for Millennium mode background.

landing_quadrant_stealth.description: Dark tactical radar array for Stealth mode background.

user_avatar_placeholder.description: High quality portrait for user profiles.

music_cover_placeholder.description: Abstract colorful shapes for music widget cover art.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a robust Theme Context using React Context or Zustand that swaps Tailwind classes/CSS variables across the entire app.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Install and use the specific fonts listed per mode.
For the Landing Page, construct a full-screen CSS Grid (2x2) for the mode quadrants. Place the Main Action Panel (Logo + auth buttons) fixed in the center.

For the Profile Widget system, use a library like 'react-grid-layout' or implement a custom CSS Grid with Framer Motion for drag-and-drop if requested, otherwise rely on a strict CSS Grid bento layout.
Ensure the Custom SVG Logo is implemented as an inline React component so its stroke and fill can react to the active theme.
Use Shadcn UI for core components but heavily override their default styling based on the active mode.
Include data-testid on every interactive element.
